text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin has been trying to master a more controlled running style, but it's just not working out, and she's fallen into a slump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest we forget about it for now, but she won't have it. She's determined to show her family that she can stand tall after a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho arrives, and Ines Fujin makes a rare work-related mistake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she takes care of the issue and nothing big comes of it, she's left shaken. For now, the most I can do is lend her my full support.
